gloss: profile; side view of a face

definitions.gloss: profile; side view of a face
definitions.explanation: The appearance of a person's face as seen from the side.
A less well-known side or aspect of a person, organization, or thing. Used figuratively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横顔|よこがお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。

examples.english: I drew his profile as he looked out the window.
On the train, the profile of the person next to me suddenly caught my eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}られざる→知る：00458_shiru⟧{横顔|よこがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
examples.english: We introduce a lesser-known side of the city.

examples.japanese: ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横顔|よこがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特集|とくしゅう}→特集：13468_tokushuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read an article featuring the different sides of the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧な{横顔|よこがお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: This program explores the surprising other sides of the athletes.

notes:
{横顔|よこがお} literally means the side view of a face, in contrast to ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧ (front view). It also has a common figurative use.

SENSE 1 — PROFILE:
Often used in aesthetic or romantic contexts to describe an attractive profile. Common collocations:
- {横顔|よこがお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧: to have a beautiful profile
- {横顔|よこがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧: to gaze at someone's profile
- {横顔|よこがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to draw a profile

SENSE 2 — ANOTHER SIDE:
Figuratively, a lesser-known aspect of a person, organization, or place. Common in journalism and documentary writing:
- ⟦{知|し}られざる→知る：00458_shiru⟧{横顔|よこがお}: an unknown side
- ⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧な{横顔|よこがお}: a surprising aspect
- ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横顔|よこがお}: the profile of a company

FORMS:
⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (side) + ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face). Note the rendaku: かお → がお.
